g.title: approvals
g.text: Single-use record bound to action, authority, execution,

g.title: note
g.text: The agent proposes the action. It cannot assert verified identity, entitlement,
approval state, audience, issuer, or time. The reference Rego policy
evaluates the final gate after credential issuance.
